name: campusflow
description: CampusFlow - Smart Student OD & Leave Management System with Attendance Integration

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run install:all && npm run seed
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
